settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Limits and switches of this installation. A value outside its limits is refused; the operator's limits in the environment always win. Every change needs a recent second factor and is recorded in the audit log.
settings.forbiddenLead: Only administrators can read or change the settings.
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
settings.note.locked: Locked by the operator: this setting is fixed at its environment value.
settings.note.forced: Forced on by the operator in the environment; it cannot be switched off here.
settings.note.envOnly: Set by the operator in the environment only.
settings.note.ignored: The stored value is no longer valid and is ignored.
settings.preview.strands: {count} active users would be left with no allowed option and could not sign in.
settings.preview.fine: No active user would be locked out.
settings.endsAt.label: Ends at (empty = open ended)
settings.error.settings_locked: This setting cannot be changed here.
settings.error.settings_locked.forced: The operator forces this setting on in the environment.
settings.error.settings_locked.not_edita: This setting is set in the environment only.
settings.error.settings_invalid.type: This is not a valid value for this setting.
settings.error.settings_invalid.below_fl: The value is below the lowest allowed.
settings.error.settings_invalid.above_ce: The value is above the highest allowed.
settings.error.settings_invalid.outside_: A chosen option is not allowed by the operator.
settings.error.settings_conflict: Someone else changed this setting meanwhile. The page was reloaded; check the value and try again.
settings.error.settings_strands_users: {count} active users would be left with no allowed option and could not sign in. Nothing was changed.
settings.error.settings_audit_unavailabl: The audit log could not be written, so nothing was changed.
settings.error.generic: The change could not be made.

settings.maintenance.user: DBLoom is in maintenance mode. You can work again when it ends.
settings.maintenance.admin: Maintenance mode is on: users cannot sign in or work. You are exempt as an administrator.
